_about: Template. Copy this file to <subdomain>.<zone>.json (for example mc.is-a.ceo.json), fill it in, and open a pull request. Delete the keys you do not need; omitting "records" entirely gives the GitHub Pages default. The subdomain may be "@" (zone apex), a wildcard (*.app, only if you already claim app), or dotted labels such as _acme-challenge.app. A/AAAA must be public IPs; CNAME/MX/NS/SRV/PTR targets must be public hostnames. "proxied" defaults to false and should stay that way for GitHub Pages.
description: One line describing what runs here.
